summary:
Plan of w219 (spec-integration r54, r55), from 1-research's notes.
r54: work run reads one glossary entry in a change list (term ids only); entries/unknown take it, write_proposals/rewrite_lists/raise_before_merge and the integrate refusal skip it; the brief and agents/initiative-round.md tell the writer terms go there only.
r55: a new module supervise_glossary.py reads the initiative's glossary-proposals; an apply brief withholds every term of one not approved.
The researcher's questions are settled without asking the person: the conflicting supervision scenarios (1475-1482, 1696-1705) are @deprecated for retired r92/r104; work run neither refuses nor strips term ids in a capability entry (r54 binds the round), so those tests stand unchanged; 0073 already rejects reading (b) for new work.
Tests broken: none (verified the step functions serve the deprecated scenarios only).
Open cases: two glossary entries, a round that applies a withheld term anyway, model check not knowing the kind glossary-proposal.
